args.message: Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

args.body:
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212) but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This changes `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI has passed on this branch (run `ci-0001`). Requesting review from code-owner so the fix can be merged and ship in today's release.
